name: chrome
description: Drive the user's real Chrome browser from the agent via the mcp-chrome extension-based MCP server — reuse login state, manage tabs, monitor network, search history, manage bookmarks, with a built-in semantic tab search.

interface.shortDescription: Drive the user's real Chrome — tabs, history, bookmarks, network.
interface.longDescription: The Chrome skill wraps hangwin/mcp-chrome, an extension-based MCP server that connects to the user's actual Chrome browser (not a spawned headless instance). It exposes 24 tools: tab and window management, screenshots, network capture via webRequest and the DevTools Debugger API, semantic search across open tabs (SIMD-accelerated vector index), page content extraction, click and fill interactions, browsing history search, and bookmark CRUD. Pure local — no data leaves the machine. Reuses the user's existing login state, cookies, and extensions. Best when login state matters more than a clean scripted environment.
defaultPrompt: Use the Chrome skill when the task requires the user's real Chrome session — their login state, bookmarks, or browsing history.
Prefer `search_tabs_content` to find content across open tabs instead of opening them one by one.
Confirm with the user before any bulk modification of bookmarks, history, or open tabs.
